candidate: Importance-weighted Q6_K projections with recurrent QKV kept at original Q8_0
origin: local model-artifact revision; no engine or live deployment change
hypothesis: Avoid directly perturbing persistent convolution and recurrent state through the 36 fused QKV inputs, while retaining weighted Q6 for 120 gate/output and full-attention projections. Other projections can still affect later recurrent inputs indirectly; this is a hypothesis, not an established diagnosis.
source_evidence: src/models/qwen4exp.cpp:624-631: separate fused QKV and output-gate projections
src/models/qwen4exp.cpp:1070-1127: QKV supplies convolution state and the recurrent attention update
src/models/qwen4exp.cpp:1129-1138: output gating and projection follow the recurrent update

selection.rule: Start from the original full map and restore exactly every blk.<layer>.attn_qkv.weight entry to q8_0; select no layers or individual tensors using development scores

conversion.verification_order: Audit all headers, shapes, types, selected payloads and allowed metadata; run the bounded development precision gate; require a full unchanged-payload audit for a survivor
conversion.scratch_policy: Discard only the failed full-scope weighted candidate shards after preserving their selected-payload hashes, dimensions, provenance and numerical result. Keep originals, unweighted Q6, calibration data and the live deployment.

evaluation.development: Reuse the pinned 16-chunk test prefix and saved baseline with identical binaries and arguments; it is not final held-out evidence
evaluation.confirmation: An untouched 16-chunk validation-split comparison, full tensor-byte audit and existing eight English task checks are required for a precision survivor
evaluation.speed: Use the actual deployed MTP3 recipe and matched original-versus-candidate Rust/JSON cases; require at least 3% geometric-mean gain, no case worse than -3%, and non-overlapping primary-case ranges in both launch orders before five-repeat confirmation
evaluation.stop_rule: One fixed architecture-based revision, not a layer/subset sweep. If it fails, stop this quantization hypothesis rather than repeatedly narrowing against the same prefix.

deployment: No promotion from a development pass alone; preserve original models, launcher and rollback
